title: 第10章 通过考核第11章 小培元丹
content_zh:
第010章 通过考核
夜静悄悄的，所有人都躺在床上。
有些在呼呼大睡，为明天的考核养精蓄锐。那些人是已经修炼出了内气，感觉自己能够轻松的举过100斤的孩童，可是又对获得内门修炼的资格没有信心。
有些则是辗转反侧难以入睡，他们一想到明天通过外门考核之后，还有一场关乎内门弟子名额的比斗便兴奋不已。那可是蜀山内门弟子啊，一入江湖便是人人夸赞的高手一流的存在啊！这能为家族带来多少的荣光啊！
学得文武艺，货于帝王家！
他们中有些不是江湖人，学艺只为报效朝廷，封个一官半职。朝廷对于江湖武人的投靠向来优待。只要各大门派的内门弟子来投，起码也是个百户的位置！百户，就是七品，一个县太爷的官位！文人寒窗苦读10年，科举中了，也不一定有个实权知县，可是武人，只要你有真本事，就算不过江湖二流的功夫，也能受一个百户的职位。因为，这天下是乱世，战争不断，需要赫赫武功来擎天保驾！
这就是一个武者的世界，软弱的书生，不适合战争！在绝对的实力面前，所有的阴谋诡计，都是浮云！任你巧舌如簧，舌战群雄，我一拳下来，都为齑粉，还有什么废话！
还有些小屁孩没有练出内气，整夜的失眠，缩在角落里偷偷流泪，从明天开始，若是他们没有极大的机遇，就会就此沉沦，沦为江湖底层人物。或许很多人都不愿再走江湖这条路，选择去做商人，去参加科举。
总之，江湖这条路虽然宽广，明天起，却再也没有了他们行走的位置。
不管其他人如何，唐安还是一如既往的端坐在自己的小床上。他的心境极为平坦，仿佛明天的考核也不过是平常的吃饭喝水一般，没什么大不了的。
确实，对他而言，本来就没什么大不了的。
现在，他已经能举起300斤的巨石了！只要不出意外，一个月内他就能突破到【天人第二重，洗髓伐经】。
到时候，再如此修炼半年，500斤的力气也只是个时间问题。他不急，他才6岁！10岁以前，只要能举起500斤的巨石，内门长老就会自动收入门墙。而且，蜀山七绝峰，七种门内绝学，任你选择。
天已大亮，唐安一整夜的端坐在自己的床上，他的身体依然灵活如猿猴。整夜的端坐，并没有让他的身体发麻。在内气循环之下，反而让他精神奕奕。这就是内气的作用，不仅可以修炼身体，还能调整精神。
“咚咚咚……”
就在这时，山门口的大鼓忽然敲响了。
小屁孩们听到这个声音，心中顿时隆隆，飞一般的就开始跑向【磨剑堂】前的大广场。
今天，所有九月份加入蜀山的弟子都要在这里参加考核。
考核通过的，便正式成为蜀山外门弟子，不仅可以获得【蜀山内功心法前六层】，而且还能获得一份属于自己的例钱。这表明，蜀山从此恩养他们，他们也自动成为了蜀山的一份子。只要没有被蜀山逐出门外，以后走在江湖上，江湖中人自然以蜀山弟子待之。为蜀山而骄傲，为蜀山而战斗。
“排好队，一个个来！能举起100斤石锁的，站在这边。要挑战200斤石锁的，站在这边。如果有谁认为自己能举起500斤石锁的，走到我的面前来！”

一道浑厚的声音响起，一下子就将千百名弟子吵嚷的声音盖过去。如果这人身处在战场上，恐怕一吼就能让全军都听见。
唐安抬起头来仔细看了那人一眼。只见他的身材魁梧，宛若铁塔，肌肉筋膜鼓起，一根根像铁链一样分明，肉体力量必定已经煅炼到了极致，力大无穷。再加上内气的加成，这样的人，若是加入军队，必定是万夫难挡的猛将！这种人混江湖，确实是太可惜了。
“咦？我见过那个人。他是【石城】戍卫军的大统领。别人都叫他黑山大统领。因为他长得黝黑，坐在那里就像一座山一样沉稳。他可是蜀山内门弟子，一流高手，修炼到了【天人第五重，神力无双】的大高手！”有个小屁孩可能见过那个男人，一语道出了他的来历。
旁边有人问道：“石城的大统领居然是蜀山的内门弟子？那蜀山的长老要是加入朝廷，朝廷需要给什么官职呢？”
那人听到这话，顿时嗤笑一声，显然是觉得对方问的这个问题很白痴。
“石城本来就是蜀山势力范围之中的大城。让蜀山内门弟子做统领乃是由蜀山长老们说了算的。朝廷？轮的到朝廷废话吗？这是川中。朝廷，管不到这里！蜀山剑派就是这里的无冕之王！蜀中的几大家族，哪个不是出自蜀山剑派？朝廷就算派人来这里任职，蜀山要是不满意，只管杀了就是。朝廷再派，我们再杀。我们川人，只认蜀山剑派。朝廷，在这里算个屁！”
那个小屁孩说的振振有辞，其他有几个孩子显然是川中子弟，听了只是微微点头，也不意外。
就在这时，那考官点到了唐安的名字。考官是蜀山的内门弟子来充当，全都是修炼到了【天人第四重，刚柔并济】的高手。
唐安听到考官点到自己名字，便立马挥去脑中的胡思乱想，径直走到了200斤的石锁之前。三个月来，他早已经脱胎换骨。精悍的气息让那个考官也不由得赞赏的点了点头。
他走到那石锁面前，嘴角微微一笑，手臂搭在石锁上，丹田内地内气飞速的旋转起来。
“喝！”的一声，那石锁便被他顺利的举过了头顶！
他举着石锁，眼神却在人群中扫着。突然，他在不远处的人群里见到了一张讨厌的脸。
“王锋！你给我等着。下午的内门弟子资格比斗，我绝不会让你好受！这三个月来，我一直在苦练，你却游手好闲，时不时下山溜达。要不是由你父亲撑腰，这蜀山剑派哪是你能撒野的地方！不过下午比斗，乃是正大光明，就算你父亲是蜀山七绝剑之一，也讲不得人情！我不敢私下报仇，是怕这蜀山门规严厉，可下午比斗，我看你怎么躲！我要正大光明的把你踩在脚底下！”
王锋看到唐安眼带恨意的看着自己，他的嘴角不屑的牵扯了一下。
“就凭你这种废物？下午我必定让你再出一次丑！废物，永远都是废物！”
唐安将石锁重重的往地上一扔，大步朝外走去。他此时心中热血沸腾，甚至有些迫不及待的想要教训王家那两兄弟。不过他也知道自己只能对付弟弟，却是无法对付那个王锐。不过没关系，只要下午胜出了，他便有了上【试剑堂】同内门弟子一起修炼的资格。只要在十岁前到达【天人第三重，融会贯通】举起500斤的巨石，便是内门的精英弟子，待遇比之一般内门弟子还要高！
不过就在这时，唐安脑中忽然响起一个声音。
【叮~系统提示：获得小培元丹一颗。需要载体注入。请宿主尽快找到相对应的载体！】
content_en:
Chapter 010 Pass the Assessment
The night was quiet, everyone was lying on the bed.
Some are fast asleep, recharging their energy for tomorrow's assessment. Those people have already cultivated their inner energy and feel that they can easily lift a child weighing 100 pounds, but they are not confident in gaining the qualifications to practice inner sect.
Some of them were tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep. They were very excited when they thought that after passing the outer sect examination tomorrow, there would be a competition for the number of inner sect disciples. That's a disciple of Shushan's inner sect. As soon as he enters the world, he is praised by everyone as a master! How much glory this can bring to the family!
If you learn martial arts, you will be able to serve in the emperor's family!
Some of them are not from the world of martial arts. They only learn arts to serve the imperial court and hold official positions. The imperial court always gave preferential treatment to warriors in the martial arts world. As long as inner disciples from various sects come to vote, they will at least be in the position of one hundred households! One hundred households is the seventh rank, the official position of a county magistrate! A literati who studied hard for 10 years and passed the imperial examination may not necessarily have a county magistrate with real power. However, as a martial artist, as long as you have real skills, you can get a position in a hundred households even if you are not a second-rate martial artist. Because the world is in troubled times, with constant wars, and great martial arts are needed to protect the sky!
This is a world of warriors. Weak scholars are not suitable for war! In the face of absolute strength, all conspiracies and machinations are nothing! No matter how eloquent you are, you can chat with all the heroes. If I punch you, they will all fall into pieces. What nonsense is there!
There are also some little brats who haven't developed their inner energy. They have been sleeping all night, huddled in the corner and secretly weeping. From tomorrow on, if they don't have a great opportunity, they will sink and become the bottom of the world. Perhaps many people no longer want to take the road of martial arts and choose to become businessmen and take part in the imperial examination.
In short, although the road of rivers and lakes is wide, starting from tomorrow, there will no longer be a place for them to walk.
Regardless of what others were doing, Tang An was still sitting upright on his little bed as always. His mood was extremely calm, as if tomorrow's assessment was just an ordinary meal and drink, no big deal.
Indeed, to him, it was no big deal in the first place.
Now, he can lift a 300-pound boulder! As long as nothing unexpected happens, he will be able to break through to the [Second Level of Heavenly Man, Marrow Cleansing and Meridian Cleansing] within a month.
By then, if you practice like this for half a year, it will only be a matter of time before you gain 500 kilograms of strength. He's not in a hurry, he's only 6 years old! Before the age of 10, as long as one could lift a boulder weighing 500 kilograms, the elders of the inner sect would automatically put it into the door wall. Moreover, there are seven unique peaks in Shu Mountain and seven kinds of unique skills within the sect, for you to choose.
It was already dawn, and Tang An had been sitting upright on his bed all night, his body still as flexible as an ape. Sitting upright all night did not make his body numb. The circulation of inner energy made him energetic. This is the function of inner Qi, which can not only cultivate the body, but also adjust the spirit.
"Dong dong dong..."
At this moment, the big drum at the mountain gate suddenly sounded.
When the little kids heard this voice, their hearts suddenly rumbled, and they started running towards the big square in front of the [Mojian Hall] like flying.
Today, all disciples who joined Shushan in September will take the assessment here.
Those who pass the assessment will officially become Shushan's outer sect disciples. Not only can they obtain [the first six levels of Shushan's internal skills and mental methods], but they can also receive their own regular money. This shows that Shushan has favored them since then, and they have automatically become a part of Shushan. As long as he is not expelled from Shushan and walks in the world, people in the world will naturally treat him as a disciple of Shushan. Be proud of Shushan and fight for Shushan.
"Line up and come one by one! Those who can lift a 100-jin stone lock stand over here. Those who want to challenge a 200-jin stone lock stand over here. If anyone thinks he can lift a 500-jin stone lock, come up to me!"
A deep voice sounded, instantly drowning out the noisy voices of hundreds of disciples. If this man were on the battlefield, he would probably be heard by the entire army with one roar.
Tang An raised his head and took a closer look at the man. I saw that his body was burly, like an iron tower, with bulging muscle fascia, each one as distinct as an iron chain. His physical strength must have been tempered to the extreme, and he was extremely powerful. Coupled with the bonus of inner energy, if such a person joins the army, he will definitely be an unstoppable general! It is indeed a pity that this kind of people are wandering around the world.
"Eh? I've seen that man. He is the commander-in-chief of the [Stone City] garrison. Others call him the commander-in-chief of Black Mountain. Because he is dark and sits there as calm as a mountain. He is a disciple of the inner sect of Shushan, a first-class master, who has cultivated to the [fifth level of heavenly beings, unparalleled divine power]!" A little kid may have seen that man, and told him his origin in one sentence.
Someone next to him asked: "The commander-in-chief of Shicheng is actually an inner disciple of Shushan? Then if the elders of Shushan join the imperial court, what official position will the imperial court need to give him?"
When the man heard this, he immediately sneered, obviously thinking that the question asked by the other party was idiotic.
"Stone City is originally a big city within Shushan's sphere of influence. It is the elders of Shushan who have the final say to let Shushan's inner disciples serve as leaders. Court? Is it the court's turn to talk nonsense? This is the middle of Sichuan. The court has no control here! Shushan Sword Sect is the uncrowned leader here. King! Which of the major families in Shu is not from the Shushan Sword Sect? If Shushan is dissatisfied, we will just kill them. We Sichuan people only recognize the Shushan Sword Sect, and they are nothing here!"
The little brat spoke plausibly. Several other children were obviously from Sichuan. They just nodded slightly and were not surprised.
At this moment, the examiner called Tang An's name. The examiners are Shushan's inner disciples, all of whom are masters who have reached the [Fourth Level of Heavenly Man, Combining Hardness and Softness].
When Tang An heard the examiner call his name, he immediately shook off all the random thoughts in his mind and walked straight to the 200-pound stone lock. In the past three months, he has been transformed. The powerful aura made the examiner nod in appreciation.
He walked up to the stone lock, smiled slightly, put his arm on the stone lock, and the inner energy in his dantian began to rotate rapidly.
With a cry of "Drink!", he successfully lifted the stone lock over his head!
He held up the stone lock, but his eyes scanned the crowd. Suddenly, he saw an annoying face in the crowd not far away.
"Wang Feng! Just wait for me. I will never make it easy for you in the inner disciple qualification competition in the afternoon! In the past three months, I have been training hard, but you have been idle and wandering down the mountain from time to time. If it weren't for your father's support, there would be no place for you to run wild in this Shushan Sword Sect. ! But the duel in the afternoon is fair and open. Even if your father is one of the Seven Ultimate Swords of Shushan, I don’t dare to take revenge in private, because I am afraid that the rules of the Shushan sect are strict. But let’s see how you can hide in the duel in the afternoon!”
Wang Feng saw Tang An looking at him with hatred in his eyes, and the corners of his mouth twitched disdainfully.
"A waste like you? I will definitely make you embarrassed again this afternoon! A waste will always be a waste!"
Tang An threw the stone lock heavily to the ground and strode out. His blood was boiling at this moment, and he even couldn't wait to teach the two Wang brothers a lesson. But he also knew that he could only deal with his younger brother, but he couldn't deal with Wang Rui. But it doesn't matter, as long as he wins in the afternoon, he will be qualified to go to the [Sword Trial Hall] to practice with the inner disciples. As long as you reach the [Third Level of Heavenly Man, Integration and Comprehension] before the age of ten and lift a 500-pound boulder, you will be an elite disciple of the inner sect, and your salary will be higher than that of ordinary inner sect disciples!But at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded in Tang An's head.
